description: Election Commission - B.D. Peter Antony was Selected as the Member of the Paliyagoda Urban Council
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government council (Paliyagoda Urban Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process for a local authority position, including the declaration of a newly elected member to fill a seat that became vacant. This falls squarely under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7), which covers electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations of elected members for government bodies.
